sections.overview: Scleronycteris ega is a Neotropical phyllostomid bat recorded in Brazil and Venezuela.
sections.identification: The English common name is Ega long-tongued bat; species-level natural-history information remains sparse.
sections.habitat: The IUCN account records it as resident in forest habitat.
sections.diet: The sources consulted do not provide a well-supported species-specific diet description.
sections.behavior: Its day-to-day behavior is poorly documented.
sections.reproduction: Species-specific breeding details are not established in the consulted assessments.
sections.ecology: The IUCN assessment calls for further research on its distribution, abundance, ecology and threats.
sections.conservation: The IUCN Red List classifies it as Data Deficient.
